text:
Proposed 5.2 km loop course from Elmina Valley Central Park on mapped roads (a proposal, not an approved route): unnamed paths near Jalan Metafasa U16/166, unnamed paths near Jalan Metafasa U16/174, unnamed paths near Jalan Metafasa U16/165, unnamed paths near Persiaran Elmina, unnamed paths near Persiaran Alstonia, Persiaran Alstonia, Persiaran Garcinia, Persiaran Alstonia, and 12 more roads, plus 7 short connecting stretches. With the course closed, 176 of 300 sample trips (walking, wheelchair and driving) change route, and 34 newly have no mapped route. Rerouted trips go about 283.8 m further (median).
1. 86 sample trips reroute onto unnamed path near Jalan Metafasa U16/1T (north-east, 104 m path) (detour pressure: high).
2. 86 sample trips reroute onto unnamed path near Persiaran Alstonia (north-west, 12 m path) (detour pressure: high).
3. 86 sample trips reroute onto unnamed path near Persiaran Alstonia (north-west, 17 m path) near 3.1805915° N, 101.5075750° E (detour pressure: high).
4. Cut off during the event (no mapped route to a centre): Elmina Lakeside Mall, Park (unnamed, OSM), NakNak Elmina and 3 more.
5. Suggestion: Consider a marshal at unnamed path near Jalan Metafasa U16/1T (north-east, 104 m path): 86 sample trips reroute onto it (86 weighted trips).
6. Suggestion: Consider a marshal at unnamed path near Persiaran Alstonia (north-west, 12 m path): 86 sample trips reroute onto it (86 weighted trips).
7. Suggestion: Review temporary two-way operation on unnamed path near Persiaran Alstonia (north, 62 m path) near 3.1807875° N, 101.5078740° E: 1 mapped one-way detour segments; staff approval is needed.
8. Suggestion: Review temporary two-way operation on unnamed path near Persiaran Alstonia (north, 13 m path) near 3.1806593° N, 101.5084580° E: 2 mapped one-way detour segments; staff approval is needed.
9. Suggestion: Review keeping one crossing point open at the mapped closure-boundary junction: 6 mapped places lose centre access. Access is not established until the alternative is assessed.
10. Suggestion: Consider splitting the closure into stretches: 95 active segments affect 176 of 300 sample trips. Separate stretches have not been simulated.
11. Suggestion: Consider shifting the time: 176 of 300 sample trips are affected at this instant. Other times have not been simulated.
Worth knowing:
• 32 sample trips start or end on the closed course: plan access for them during the event.
• 35 more suggestions of the same kinds are not listed.
• 21 of the 300 sample trips had no mapped route before the event (data gaps, not the event).
• Proposed course on mapped roads, not an approved route.
• Detour pressure, estimated from mapped road class and sample trips, not traffic counts.
• Peak weights are an assumed travel pattern, not measured.
